stem: Which situation is best represented by the inequality \( \frac{x}{12} \geq 7 \)?

options.label: F
options.text: Emily divided x crayons into 12 boxes, and there were at most 7 crayons in each box.

options.label: G
options.text: Emily separated x books on 12 shelves, and there were more than 7 books on each shelf.

options.label: H
options.text: Emily poured x ounces of juice into 12 cups, and each cup had no less than 7 ounces of juice.

options.label: J
options.text: Emily shared x cookies among 12 people, and each person received less than 7 cookies.
